en.headline: 221 own commits across 11 repos, 7 releases, and one open PR
en.teaser: A month of skill tooling, pixel-art CLI work and release engineering, plus issue reports filed upstream on PowerToys and OpenChamber.
en.overview:
Work in this window centred on a family of OpenCode skills and small command-line tools, with most of the effort going into documentation, release packaging and correctness fixes rather than new surface area. The user made 221 own commits plus 577 automated commits, opened 1 pull request, and took 3 issue actions. No reviews were recorded, and every day of the window has data.

### Skill tooling and sandbox knowledge

The largest single block of work was in `opencode-agent-sandbox`, where 87 commits went into a knowledge base: collecting measured results on V2 plugin and tool registration, correcting two earlier claims about schema and registration, documenting the division of labour between three review commands, and recording the four installable layers of the GitHub agent plus CLI/MCP selection and instruction-injection levels. Later commits tightened the plain-language skill after an oracle review and merged the WAL mechanism notes into the storage document. One pull request was opened here and remains open.

`opencode-skill-management` shipped two releases, v1.1.0 and v1.2.0. The 1.1.0 work changed all four actions to return a single JSON object with a declared output schema, added a bilingual documentation site, and documented npm installation. The 1.2.0 line fixed a false divergence warning in `list`, normalised frontmatter booleans, serialised disable/enable writes to stop concurrent overwrites, and made a failed sidecar write non-fatal.

### Pixel logo CLI and model picker

`pixel-logo-toolkit` published v0.2.0 and v0.3.0. The first tagged release introduced the bilingual CLI and English-first README; 0.3.0 added automatic text wrapping with CJK-aware breaking, proportional font-size fallback when content overflows, a 40-image command gallery, and fixes for Korean font selection and right-side decoration width.

`opencode-go-model-picker` published v2.0.0, v3.0.0 and v3.0.1. Version 2.0.0 introduced priced accounting with per-message pricing and Console MCP calibration; 3.0.0 collapsed seven Markdown files into two and nine runtime scripts into one entry point; 3.0.1 enforced the candidate model menu, made chain length follow the source, and had `check` re-derive numbers instead of trusting the file. Commits also fixed calibration re-stamping an old bias with today's date and moved test prompts into `tests/`.

### Plugins, reports and smaller repos

`dsh-openchamber-plugins` received 19 commits porting OpenChamber features into DSH plugins, adding a hidden-files toggle, an `/init` project-instructions skill and a zh-doc-sync skill, plus Chinese README and porting rules. `dsh-ecosystem-report` got mobile viewport fixes at 375 and 414 px, a single-button theme switcher with popup menu, visual refinements, and a GitHub repository button with LICENSE and Pages notes.

The profile repository `sogeisetsu` saw 13 own commits alongside 577 automated ones, covering daily-report workflow gating, feeding full release notes into the AI summary, a Xiaohongshu Dots provider as a fallback, and a rule rejecting bare issue counts. `sopen-translate` corrected the G2 status and documented the Google 2 key path; `myBlog` added screenshots of a DSH stats display bug.

### Upstream issue work

Outside the user's own repositories, an issue was opened on `microsoft/PowerToys` about a Shortcut Guide NullReferenceException, and an issue was opened on `openchamber/openchamber` about the settings MCP page omitting the Console MCP server; a comment was also left on an OpenChamber storage-management issue.

v1.2.0 fixed the false divergence warning in list and serialised disable/enable writes.
v0.3.0 added automatic CJK-aware text wrapping and proportional overflow fallback.
v3.0.0 cut the skill from seven Markdown files to two and from nine scripts to one entry point.
v3.0.1 enforced the candidate model menu and made check re-derive numbers.
Opened a pull request that remains open.
Opened an issue about Shortcut Guide hold-Win activation throwing NullReferenceException.
Opened an issue about Settings > MCP omitting the Console MCP server added at runtime.

zh.headline: 11 个仓库 221 次本人提交、7 个版本发布与 1 个待合并 PR
zh.teaser: 本月主要围绕技能工具链、像素风命令行工具与发布工程展开，同时向上游 PowerToys 和 OpenChamber 提交了问题报告。
zh.overview:
本窗口的工作集中在一组 OpenCode 技能和几个小型命令行工具上，投入最多的是文档、发布打包与正确性修复，而非新增功能面。本人提交 221 次，另有 577 次自动提交；新开 1 个 PR，产生 3 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论）。没有评审记录，窗口内每天都有数据。

### 技能工具链与沙箱知识库

工作量最大的是 `opencode-agent-sandbox`，87 次提交几乎都用于知识库：收录 V2 插件与工具注册的实测结果，纠正此前关于 schema 与 Registration 的两处误传，记录三种审查命令的分工，并整理 GitHub agent 的四层可安装物、CLI/MCP 选型与指令注入层级。后续提交按 oracle 评审收紧了 plain-language 技能，并把 WAL 机制并入存储文档。该仓库新开的 PR 目前仍处于打开状态。

`opencode-skill-management` 发布了 v1.1.0 与 v1.2.0。1.1.0 把四个动作改为返回单个 JSON 对象并声明输出 schema，新增中英双语文档站，补充 npm 安装说明。1.2.0 修复 `list` 误报技能分歧、统一 frontmatter 布尔值解析、将 disable/enable 串行化以避免并发覆盖，并让 sidecar 写入失败不再把成功的配置变更判为错误。

### 像素 Logo 工具与模型选择器

`pixel-logo-toolkit` 发布了 v0.2.0 与 v0.3.0。首个正式版本带来双语命令行与英文优先的 README；0.3.0 增加自动折行（中文按字断行、拉丁文按空格断行）、内容溢出时按比例缩小字号并在 9px 处告警、40 张命令示例画廊，并修正韩文字体选择与右侧装饰宽度。

`opencode-go-model-picker` 发布了 v2.0.0、v3.0.0 与 v3.0.1。2.0.0 引入按消息计价的成本核算与 Console MCP 校准；3.0.0 把七个 Markdown 文件压缩为两个、九个运行时脚本合并为一个入口；3.0.1 强制候选模型菜单、让链长随来源变化，并让 `check` 重新推导数字而非信任文件。提交还修复了校准用当天日期重盖旧偏差的问题，并把测试提示词移入 `tests/`。

### 插件、报告与小型仓库

`dsh-openchamber-plugins` 收到 19 次提交，把 OpenChamber 功能移植为 DSH 插件，新增隐藏文件开关、`/init` 项目指令技能与 zh-doc-sync 技能，并补充中文 README 与移植规则。`dsh-ecosystem-report` 修复了 375 与 414 像素真实视口下的移动端布局，把主题切换改为单按钮加弹出菜单，做了视觉精修，并加上 GitHub 仓库按钮、LICENSE 与 Pages 说明。

个人主页仓库 `sogeisetsu` 有 13 次本人提交和 577 次自动提交，内容包括日报 workflow 的生成物校验门禁、把完整 release notes 喂给 AI 摘要、接入小红书 Dots 作为兜底来源，以及拒收裸 issue 计数的规则。`sopen-translate` 更正 G2 状态并补充 Google 2 密钥获取路径；`myBlog` 增加了 DSH 统计显示缺陷的截图。

### 上游 issue

在本人仓库之外，向 `microsoft/PowerToys` 提交了一个关于快捷指南按住 Win 激活抛出 NullReferenceException 的 issue，向 `openchamber/openchamber` 提交了一个关于设置页 MCP 未显示运行时 Console MCP 服务器的 issue，并在一个存储管理 issue 下留言。

highlights.text: v1.1.0 把四个动作改为返回单个 JSON 对象并声明输出 schema。
v1.2.0 修复 list 的技能分歧误报，并将 disable/enable 写入串行化。
v0.3.0 增加中文按字断行的自动折行与溢出时按比例缩小字号。
v3.0.0 把技能从七个 Markdown 文件压到两个、九个脚本合并为一个入口。
v3.0.1 强制候选模型菜单，并让 check 重新推导数字。
新开一个 PR，目前仍处于打开状态。
提交 issue，反映快捷指南按住 Win 激活时抛出 NullReferenceException。
提交 issue，反映设置页 MCP 未显示运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
